_comment: The card tables editor/scripts READS rather than hand-lists (task 885). Each is a projection of an app-side SSOT,
and src/cards/__tests__/card-tables-manifest.test.ts fails when either side is edited alone:
cardSidecars        panel → { file, listKey, writeback } — every card-hosting sidecar a card id resolves into.
`writeback: true` rows are apply_response.PANEL_TO_SIDECAR (new-card insertion targets);
the rest are EXTRA_CARD_SIDECARS (searched, never appended to). `tsPanel` is the app's
PanelKind for the same store. Pinned to SIDECAR_COLLECTIONS (src/lib/sidecar-merge.ts),
archiveOriginPanels the panels /editor/archive-card admits (apply_response._ANCHORED_PANEL_CARDS) — equal to
is one the app can restore.
bodyFields          which record field(s) edit-card's --body writes, per kind — derived from CARD_REGISTRY[kind]
.content: plain = no bodyField, body is `text`; richOnly = bodyField `content`, no `text`
mirror; richMirror = bodyField `content` + a `text` mirror kept in sync.
sidecarCollections  file → [{ key, idFields }] — equal to SIDECAR_COLLECTIONS (src/lib/sidecar-merge.ts). The writeback's
in-pen three-way merge (_common.json_merge3, task 941) identity-merges exactly these arrays.
suggestionLanding   may a suggestion's replacement land? (task 957) familyMeansDeletion = FAMILY_MEANS_DELETION and
apply_response's accept refuses an empty replacement for a family where it does not mean a cut.
Python kind tokens are card_by_id.card_kind's (a revisions comment is the legacy `comment`; spine `revision-comment`).

suggestionLanding.noReplacementText: No replacement text yet — this suggestion has nothing to put in the paper.
